data.fund_name: Aditya Birla Sun Life Multi Asset Allocation Fund
data.fund_type: An open ended scheme investing in Equity, Debt and Commodities.
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the Scheme is to provide long term capital appreciation by investing across asset classes like Equity, Debt, Commodities, & units of REITs & InvITs. The Scheme does not guarantee/indicate any returns. There can be no assurance that the objective of the Scheme will be achieved
data.asset_allocation:
Equity & Equity related instruments# - 65-80% - High
Debt and Money Market Instruments ^- 10-25% - Low to Moderate
Commodities* - 10-25% - Moderate to High
Units issued by InvITs - 0-10% - Moderate to High# (including equity ETFs) 
^ (including Debt ETFs)
*Including Gold and Gold related instruments, Silver and Silver related instruments.
data.benchmark: 65% BSE 200 + 25% CRISIL Short Term Bond Index + 5% of Domestic prices of Gold + 5% of Domestic prices of Silver
data.exit_load: For redemption / switch out upto 30% of units within 1 year from the date of allotment - Nil. For redemption / switch out of more than 30% of units within 1 year from the date of allotment – 1.00% of applicable NAV. For redemption/switch out after 1 year from the date of allotment - Nil.
